# CalmOps

> > A comprehensive entertainment and culture resource covering TV listings, viral memes, streaming services, and celebrity news across platforms like TikTok, Twitter, and YouTube.

This site aggregates content from major entertainment sources including TV Guide for television schedules and streaming recommendations, Know Your Meme for viral internet culture documentation, and Scientific American for science journalism. It serves as a multi-platform guide to contemporary media, trending content, and cultural phenomena.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- TV Guide and television listings
- Know Your Meme documentation
- Streaming services and entertainment
- Viral memes and image macros
- Celebrity and entertainment news
- Social media platforms (Twitter, Facebook, YouTube)
- Dance trends and catchphrases
- Sports programming schedules
- Scientific American content
- Exploitable meme formats
- Cultural nostalgia content

## TV & Streaming Guide

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage with streaming recommendations, TV reviews & entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule & channel listings for shows, movies & programs by provider
- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Daily live sports schedule for MLB, NBA, NHL, UEFA & college games

## Viral Memes & Internet Culture

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl & cat art, viral on TikTok & Twitter
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swimming gesture
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman
